mechanism: Amikacin-induced nephrotoxicity may impair oxycodone metabolism and clearance, while oxycodone's CNS depression may mask symptoms of ototoxicity; additive renal risk in patients with compromised kidney function.
action: Monitor renal function closely, assess for signs of amikacin ototoxicity, and adjust oxycodone dosing if renal impairment develops; consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
